_doc: THE RECORD OF THE 2026-09-19 PARISH-CHURCH TEXT ORDER, beside docs/shift-records/2026-09-18-content-coherence.json and docs/shift-records/2026-09-18-pressure-sentence-agreement.json and deliberately NOT folded into either: those records have had their acts, and a record is never edited after one, only joined by a new record that says what moved next. This one is the TEXT half of ODQ 934.13, whose LABEL half (the display seam) moved no byte at all and needed no record. The lane does NOT execute the act: the chair runs UPDATE_GOLDEN and the door from the committed tree. THE SAME TWO GATES STAND BETWEEN THIS RECORD AND ITS ACT: espionage-dormancy-fence refuses its own movement as a STOP outside a named chartered window, and the fence hash below was measured on the LANE's tree - the chair re-measures on the consist and uses that figure.
cause: THE READER STOPPED MEETING 'PARISH CHURCH' IN THE SENTENCE UNDER A LABEL THAT SAYS HOUSE OF WORSHIP. ODQ 934.13 cured the LABEL with a read-time display seam and left generated TEXT alone by design, because that text is spread onto the hashed settlement by assembleInstitutions - so the card's heading read 'Houses of worship (2-5)' while its own body read 'Several parishes, each with its church.' The owner ordered the words moved as well; this record is that act's provenance. WHAT MOVED, AND WHERE. 23 authored strings across five files, every one of them reader-facing text and NOT ONE of them an identifier: src/data/supplyChainData.js's chain label 'Parish & Faith' -> 'Faith & Worship' (persisted into economicState.activeChains[].label at computeActiveChains.js:371); 8 `desc` strings in src/data/institutionalCatalog.js and 7 seeded variant strings in src/data/institutionDescVariants.js; src/generators/economy/viability.js's suggestedFixes ['Add Parish Church, Temple, or Monastery'] -> ['Add a house of worship, a temple or a monastery'], which a reader meets in the Viability tab and CoherencePanel; and 6 tier-gate `reason` strings in src/data/spatialData.js that structuralValidator puts on the settlement and ViabilityTab prints. WHAT DELIBERATELY DID NOT MOVE: every catalogue KEY, every `requires` array and the 'church' TAG. The key is the identifier ~158 sites match by substring; the 'church' tag is read by historyGenerator.js:115. Renaming either would be the schema split 934.13 refused. MEASURED, SINGLE-VARIABLE, by generating the whole corpus twice on this box - once with the five files restored to the lane tip 66369414f, once with the edit - and diffing the settlement JSON path by path. 453 OF 525 ROWS MOVE on generator-golden-master, over exactly TWO PATH TEMPLATES and no others. $.economicState.activeChains[*].label: 453 rows, 453 changes, ONE distinct substitution. $.institutions[*].desc: 369 rows, 558 changes, ELEVEN distinct substitutions. The desc rows are a strict SUBSET of the label rows, so the chain label alone accounts for the whole 453. By tier: thorp 12/84, hamlet 84/84, village 84/84, town 105/105, city 84/84, metropolis 84/84 - the thorp shortfall is the tier that draws neither the faith chain nor a religious institution in most of its configurations. ZERO STRUCTURAL MOVEMENT: no array length and no key set moves anywhere in 525 settlements, and the 525-key set is IDENTICAL before and after. THE TWO LOUDEST-LOOKING EDITS COST NOTHING, AND THAT WAS MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: viability.js's suggestedFixes and all six spatialData tier-gate reasons move 0 ADDITIONAL rows, because neither the very-high-religion warning nor a religious tier-gate violation fires anywhere in this corpus or in the fence's. They are cured because a reader can still reach them off-corpus, not because they showed up in a hash. ON THE FENCE'S OWN 360-SETTLEMENT DRIVEN CORPUS, 348 OF 360 ROWS MOVE (thorp 48/60, hamlet, village, town, city and metropolis 60/60 each). 360/360 hashes stay DISTINCT on both sides, so the generator has not stopped seeing its seed. TOTALITY CONTROL: with the five files restored, this box reproduces the committed constant 38a26ac1ca7b7e5bb81d9e7795851b57ca32d50f5a36d78b41e564ccd731f196 EXACTLY, so the movement is attributable to this edit and to nothing else the lane carries. The constant reads 38a26ac1ca7b7e5bb81d9e7795851b57ca32d50f5a36d78b41e564ccd731f196 -> 118e50e1594933d686708e28fd81b9b3a5b5e15c4da0244a807a458157f06c3d AT THE LANE'S TIP; the chair re-measures on the consist and writes THAT figure, because the constant is written from the tree the act runs in. WHAT DID NOT MOVE, measured rather than assumed: the dossier-prose manifest (proseComposed) and the drawn-prose anchors walker, the golden-freeze walker, the institution table walker, the institution label-seam census, the four NPC dormancy goldens, the institution vocabulary and name-integrity pins - 270 passed across those eleven files; and the five SIBLING espionage fences (mission, rider, gauntlet, products, doctrine) with the PDF golden view model - 55 passed across those six.
